voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: San Francisco Bay, August, nineteen forty-two. A Navy blimp lifted off on patrol with two officers aboard. Hours later, it came down empty.
Near the Farallon Islands, they radioed that they were investigating an oil slick. They never radioed again.
The airship drifted ashore and came to rest in a street in Daly City. The gondola door was open.
The parachutes, the life raft, and a briefcase of classified papers were still aboard. The radio worked.
Searchers found no trace of either man. What happened to them has never been established.
